Callout.Name: Trespass at a Quarry
Callout.Message: People on a disused quarry site.
Callout.Advisory: Three or four on foot, no vehicles.

Script.Line: They are climbing on the plant. That is all it is.
It is a disused site and there is a shaft at the back of it.
If one of them goes down that shaft, this becomes a different call.

Lines.Approach: Four of them in a place they have no business being. Nobody is hurt, which is not guaranteed there.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
